messages:
sasha: Heads-up — macos runner flapping. ExporterTest::Init timed out on macos-latest-3, 3 failures in the last hour. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5877. ping @lee @maria for bisect/last-green

lee: which job/runner exactly? can you paste the job link and failing log?

sasha: job: macos-latest-3 / build 5877 — failing during test startup with socket/connect errors. logs: /builds/5877/logs

devops-bot: Build #5877 \u2022 macos-latest-3 \u2022 failed \u2022 logs: /builds/5877/logs

maria: initial glance: failure cluster started around 2051009300 on that pool. could be an infra image change or a test regression. @aj any macOS infra changes pushed recently?

aj: No macos image bumps in the last 36h. I did merge a small cleanup in the harness (commit b7d9c11) but that was linux-only.

lee: can someone run last-green for macos-latest-3? our last_green tool sometimes misses darwin pools.

sasha: ran `tools/last_green --pool=macos-latest-3 --test=eng/integration/exporter_test` returned nothing for the last 72h. odd.

maria: plan: try a bisect limited to commits touching exporter.* + test harness range. start from known-good linux sha 2050998000 -> HEAD 2051010000. I'll script CI bisect.

lee: trying local repro on macOS VM first: `bazel test //eng/integration:exporter_test --test_output=streamed` — reproduces consistently with these lines:
```
[ RUN      ] ExporterTest.Init
E1117 09:12:05.321 exporter.cc:92] connect(): Operation would block
E1117 09:12:05.654 exporter_test.cc:48] ASSERT_TRUE(server.Start()) failed
[  FAILED  ] ExporterTest.Init (1301 ms)
```

sasha: looks like nonblocking connect or socket exhaustion. maybe the new connect path didn't handle EWOULDBLOCK on macos like linux.

maria: @lee can you git-blame exporter.cc and nearby commits touching connect/timeout logic?

lee: git blame points at commit abc1234 (PR #4177 by rafael) that changed the exporter connect flow to non-blocking + polling.

aj: PR #4177 landed earlier this week but linux CI stayed green. macOS sockets sometimes return different errno for the same sequence. could explain platform-specific flakes.

sasha: suggestion: (1) brief merge freeze on main (light hold) while we bisect; (2) run git bisect across suspected range; (3) prepare revert/patch if culprit confirmed. @buildcop can we hold?

buildcop: placing a 20m hold on merges to main. queuing a verbose rerun of the failing macos job.

maria: kicking off CI-driven bisect: `git bisect start --term-bad=HEAD --term-good=2050998000` and iterating across macos pool. will post progress.

devops-bot: Rerun queued: Build #5879 (macos-latest-3) \u2022 verbose logs enabled

lee: I'll add instrumentation to count open fds/connect attempts while I repro locally.

maria: bisect update: tested midpoint 2051004500 -> good; 2051007600 -> bad. narrowing further.

sasha: if bisect lands on rafael's change pls ping him and prepare a revert so we can get main stable.

maria: bisect result: suspect commit abc1234 (PR #4177). repeated runs on that commit fail 2/3 times on macos pool. parent commit is consistently green.

lee: confirmed locally with the PR apply — non-blocking connect returns EWOULDBLOCK/EAGAIN semantics on macOS not handled by our polling loop, causing startup to abort.

aj: I'll open a revert/patch to restore previous blocking connect behavior on macos or add proper errno handling.

sasha: good. @buildcop please extend hold until revert merges and we get two clean CI runs.

buildcop: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/4271 (revert of abc1234) assigned to @aj. Hold extended until merge + 2 successful macos runs.

devops-bot: Build #5885 (post-revert) started on macos-latest-3

maria: monitoring: two green runs so far on macos. I'll keep an eye for 45 minutes and then we can lift the hold if stable.

sasha: thanks all. @rafael we'll sync on a cross-platform fix after this; please add macos CI for the exporter test to catch regressions.

rafael: thanks for the fast triage — I'll dig into proper EAGAIN handling and open a portable fix after the revert lands. sorry about the noise. ❤️

lee: as a follow-up: add a small macos-specific integration test harness shim to exercise non-blocking connects in CI.

sasha: agree. lifting thread once hold is removed. :thumbsup:
